d:
This is one of those pulaos that will really surprise you with its flavour. The rice and vegetables are cooked in fresh coconut milk, and what makes it even more special is the generous amount of tender coconut malai pieces that go into it. You get that lovely, fresh bite of coconut in every mouthful, and trust me, it tastes absolutely incredible!
One of my favourite veg pulaos, and I really think you should give this one a try. The full written recipe is in the description below. Happy Cooking!
